newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis shows strength.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis shows strength.

text.p: Basis levels for dark northern spring wheat continued to firm as farmer selling remained slack, grain merchandisers in the northern Plains and Pacific Northwest said Wednesday.
Weather conditions in the northern Plains were cold but dry Wednesday, allowing farmers to continue to plant spring crops or run fertilizer in fields.

"Spot markets are feeling pretty firm due to a lack of cars. We'll probably see this for another few days until farmers get their fieldwork done and can start watching the board again," a Minneapolis grain merchandiser said.

Meanwhile, fieldwork continued to advance well in Montana. One grain dealer estimated that planting was 85 percent complete in the eastern part of the state and was 65 to 70 percent done in central Montana.
